about: The tractus of the formulary “Saint Matthias the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Your friends, O God, are exceedingly honorable; their principality is exceedingly strengthened. Were I to recount them, they would outnumber the sands. You have granted him his heart’s desire. You refused not the wish of his lips. For You welcomed him with goodly blessings. You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
